taxonomic_note: Legacy Master Plant Pool name Lesquerella grandiflora normalized to current accepted Paysonia grandiflora.
look_here_first: Showy bladderpod relative with relatively large yellow flowers; it belongs in Paysonia rather than Physaria under the modern split.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local legacy source; modern Lesquerella split places L. grandiflora in Paysonia; GRIN treats Paysonia grandiflora as native in Texas.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; broader exact-county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.
best_field_traits: yellow flowers relatively large for the group
morphology_keys.comparison_training: The major learner cue here is taxonomic: this one is Paysonia, not Physaria. It is the 'bigflower' member of the old Lesquerella set.
